description: Before handing a worktree to an agent, assert it is clean: run git status --porcelain and fail the run with a clear message if there are uncommitted changes from a previous run. For branch collision (deterministic branch name already exists): if the branch has no unmerged commits relative to the base branch, reset it to the base branch tip and reuse. If the branch has unmerged commits, fail the run with a message rather than silently discarding work.
title: Clean-state assertion and branch collision handling
